contradictions.what: Rep says nothing could be done and no moment existed, yet admits our useful analysis arrived three weeks late after the test finished, and that findings were fixable.
Rep says we weren't really pitching, but then describes answering with the Authorization Boost deck and offering a roadmap session.
Rep calls the account healthy and not on anyone's list, but Stefan says we only reached out when he said he was leaving.

Stefan told rep the CFO approval happened two weeks before the last call, yet the rep says she learned of evaluation only at the renewal notice, implying the decision was made before she was involved.
Rep says she did not know a head of payments had been hired, while owning an account whose payments owner left last year.

dodges.question: Which ones? (which international markets looked bad)
dodges.what: Rep said she didn't know exactly and never saw the analysis.

dodges.question: When did you first feel this was lost? What happened right before?
dodges.what: Answered there was no moment and nothing to do, later contradicted by late analysis and missing contact.

dodges.question: Which part of our pitch got a reaction, and which got silence?
dodges.what: Reframed as not pitching; gave no clear reaction to any part, only silence on uplift number.

outcome_signals.what: Customer asked to split the contract and went with local acquiring for international.
Only part of the business moved: roughly half the account was international; US stayed.
Rep frames it as decided before engagement.
